label: Semantic validity in a fixed world interpretation
definition: Every world in the supplied interpretation that satisfies all premises also satisfies the conclusion. A singleton containing p entails p by reflexivity. The broader class of nontrivial or actually used inferences is a separate selection.
note: Analyst use of the existing ReflectiveCoherence semantics. World adequacy, actual reasoning performance and normative authority are separate from this model-relative definition.
